droseri-kotosalata.title: Fresh chicken salad
steps: Boil the chicken in a pan of salted water.
Leave it to cool, then cut it into small pieces.
Grate the carrots and finely chop the fennel.
In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients (chicken, yoghurt, carrots, fennel, mayonnaise) and season with salt.
Put the bowl in the fridge for about an hour.
Serve the chicken salad on lettuce or red cabbage leaves!

tonosalata-riziou.title: Tuna and rice salad
steps: Boil the rice in a pan of salted water.
In a large salad bowl, mix all the vegetables, the mozzarella and the tuna, add 2-3 tbsp olive oil and season with salt.
Drain the rice and leave it to cool for 1-2 minutes.
Add it to the salad bowl and mix well with the other ingredients, adding 1-2 more tbsp olive oil.
Add the Parmesan.
Finish the dish with a little lemon or balsamic vinegar.

kokkines-pipergies-sto-fourno.title: Baked red peppers
kokkines-pipergies-sto-fourno.description: A spicy meze to whet the appetite.
steps: Wash the peppers well, cut them in half lengthways and remove the seeds.
Heat the frying oil in a small saucepan.
Fry the peppers in the hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes, then place them on a plate lined with kitchen paper to cool.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
In a bowl, mix the anthotyro with 3 tbsp graviera, the olive oil and the mint, and season with salt and pepper.
Lightly salt the peppers, which will have cooled by now.
Brush a small non-stick baking tin with oil and place the peppers in it.
Fill the pepper 'boats' with the anthotyro mixture.
Cover each 'boat' with 2 tsp béchamel and sprinkle with grated graviera.
Season lightly with pepper and bake for about 20 minutes.

eliokeftedakia.title: Olive meatballs
steps: Remove the stones from the olives and chop them finely.
Finely chop the onion and the rocket.
In a bowl, mix the mince, olives, onion, rocket and egg by hand, and add salt.
Add the breadcrumbs, tomato juice, olive oil and pepper, and knead until the mixture is light and fluffy.
Cover the bowl with cling film and put it in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Take the mince out of the fridge and, using 2 tablespoons at a time, shape it into round meatballs.
Fill a frying pan halfway with oil and heat it over a medium heat.
Tip the flour into a deep plate and roll the meatballs in it until evenly coated.
When the oil is hot, carefully add the meatballs (a few at a time) and fry them until well browned on both sides.
Remove them from the pan and place them on a plate lined with kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil.
Serve with freshly fried potatoes, or as a starter with a cool glass of ouzo!

mpiftekia-lahanikon.title: Vegetable burgers
steps: Mix all the ingredients well.
Adjust the amount of breadcrumbs depending on how malleable the mince is.
Put it in the fridge for about 15 minutes, covering the bowl with cling film.
Oil a non-stick baking tin and preheat the oven to 200°C.
Take the mince out of the fridge and shape the burgers, oiling your hands with a little oil.
Bake until well browned on both sides.
Serve with a generous mixed salad or a little rice.

polixromi-omeleta.title: Colourful omelette

items: 1 red pepper, cut into small squares

steps: Fry the potatoes, courgettes and peppers separately, season them with salt and pepper and leave them for a minute on a plate lined with kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil.
In a bowl, beat the eggs with the milk and Parmesan, adding a little salt and pepper.
In a wide non-stick frying pan, add the potatoes, courgettes and pepper and, over a low heat, pour in the egg mixture.
When the underside is cooked, carefully flip the omelette.
Serve hot, sprinkled with a soft melting cheese of your choice.

xortosoupa-me-avgolemono.title: Vegetable soup with avgolemono (egg and lemon)
xortosoupa-me-avgolemono.description: A very tasty soup that warms even the coldest winter days.
steps: Grate the courgettes and carrot and finely chop the onion.
Cut the potato and tomato into cubes.
Fill a medium pan halfway with water and add the vegetables, rice and stock cube.
Season with salt and pepper and leave to boil over a medium heat.
When the rice is ready (after about 20 minutes), make sure the vegetables are cooked too and take the pan off the heat.
Now make the avgolemono by beating the eggs with the lemon juice in a bowl.
Add a little of the soup liquid to the avgolemono and mix well.
Pour the avgolemono into the soup and stir.

spanaki-sto-fourno.title: Baked spinach
steps: Finely chop the onion.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over a medium heat and lightly sauté the onion.
Add the spinach, sauté it lightly too, and pour in the water.
Season with salt and pepper and add the dill.
Stirring now and then, cook the spinach until it is done and has absorbed all the liquid.
Take it off the heat, tip it onto a platter and cut it up with a knife.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Grease a small baking tin or a Pyrex dish well.
Lay the puff pastry sheet in the tin, covering the base and sides.
Spread the spinach evenly over the pastry and sprinkle with the kefalograviera.
Grate the ladotyri or cut it into small cubes.
Mix the ladotyri with the béchamel and spread the mixture over the spinach.
Bake for about 30 minutes, take it out of the oven and leave it to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

karmponara.title: Carbonara
steps: Put the spaghetti on to boil in a pan.
In a non-stick frying pan, sauté the bacon with a tablespoon of olive oil, deglaze with the white wine and take it off the heat.
Beat the yolks with the milk in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
When the spaghetti is ready, drain it and add it to the frying pan.
Stir with the bacon over a low heat for less than 1 minute, then turn off the heat.
For a creamier carbonara, add the butter at this stage.
Slowly pour in the yolks and milk, stirring very well, and add the Parmesan.
The carbonara is ready to serve.

tortellinia-me-parmezana-kai-krema-galak.title: Tortellini with Parmesan and cream

items: 400 g fresh tortellini filled with spinach or cheese

steps: Boil the tortellini and drain them.
Sauté the onion in the butter and deglaze with the white wine.
Leave it to boil for a few minutes and add the cream.
Season with salt and pepper and leave to simmer for another 3-4 minutes.
Pour the cream sauce over the tortellini, which you have placed in a small baking tin.
Sprinkle the top with the Parmesan and put the tin in the oven for a few minutes, until the Parmesan turns golden.

saltsa-me-kima.title: Meat sauce
saltsa-me-kima.description: A favourite sauce to go with pasta, adding plenty of flavour.
steps: Finely chop the onion.
In a pan, lightly sauté the onion over a medium heat.
Add the mince, season with salt and pepper and sauté for a few minutes.
Add the cinnamon and deglaze the mince with the white wine.
Leave to bubble for 2-3 minutes, add the tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Cook over a medium heat until the excess liquid has been absorbed, for about 20 to 25 minutes.

risoto-me-manitaria-champignon.title: Champignon mushroom risotto
steps: Heat the oil and lightly sauté the onion.
In another pan, heat the water and add the stock cube.
Add the mushrooms and then the rice.
Stir over a low heat and deglaze with the white wine.
Add enough stock from the other pan to cover the rice.
Leave it to cook until all the liquid is absorbed and add a little salt and pepper.
Keep adding stock in small amounts until the rice is tender.
When the rice is cooked, add the grated salty cheese.
For a creamier risotto, add a tablespoon of butter just before taking it off the heat.

risoto-me-safran.title: Saffron risotto
steps: Bring the water to the boil in a pan and add the stock cube.
In another pan, heat the olive oil over a medium heat.
Add the rice and sauté it lightly.
Deglaze with white wine.
Add enough stock from the other pan to cover the rice.
Leave it to cook until all the liquid is absorbed and add a little salt and pepper.
Keep adding stock in small amounts until the rice is tender.
When the rice is cooked, add the saffron and stir well.
Add the Parmesan, stir, and add a tablespoon of butter if you want a creamier risotto.
Take it off the heat and serve with Parmesan sprinkled on top.

italiko-pastitsio-me-tiria-kai-manitaria.title: Italian pastitsio with cheese and mushrooms
steps: Cut the mozzarella into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix the anthotyro with 3 tbsp olive oil to soften it, and season with salt and pepper.
Drain the mushrooms of their oil and tip them onto a plate.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Butter a rectangular baking tin well.
In a pan of salted water, boil the lasagne sheets for 7-8 minutes, adding 4 to 5 at a time. Lift them out of the pan with a spatula, taking care not to break them.
Cover the base of the tin with 3-4 lasagne sheets (depending on the size of your tin).
Spread over ⅓ of the mozzarella, ⅓ of the gorgonzola, ⅓ of the mushrooms and ¼ of the Parmesan.
Add 5-6 tbsp béchamel and cover with a layer of lasagne.
Repeat the same process another 3 times.
Cover the last (fourth) layer with the remaining béchamel and Parmesan.
Season with pepper and sprinkle with freshly grated nutmeg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, take it out of the oven and leave it to cool for half an hour before serving, so that it cuts more easily.

penes-me-kapnisto-solomo.title: Penne with smoked salmon
steps: Put the penne on to boil in salted water.
Cut the smoked salmon into long strips and finely chop the rocket.
In a deep non-stick frying pan, heat the olive oil over a low heat.
Add the salmon, sauté it lightly and deglaze with the wine.
Add the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Leave the cream to bubble for 2-3 minutes, add the rocket and take the pan off the heat.
Drain the penne, add them to the pan and stir well.

penes-me-kolokitha-kai-xoriatiko-loukani.title: Penne with pumpkin and village sausage
steps: Add the penne to a pan of boiling salted water.
Finely chop the onion, cut the sausage into small pieces and grate the pumpkin.
In a deep frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat.
Add the onion and sauté lightly.
Add the sausage and fry for a few minutes until browned.
Add the pumpkin and the chopped parsley, mix well and pour in the wine.
Leave to bubble for 1 to 2 minutes and add half a glass of water.
Keeping the heat medium, cook the sausage and pumpkin until most of the liquid has been absorbed, then lower the heat.
Drain the penne and add them to the frying pan.
Mix well and take the pan off the heat.
Serve with plenty of grated graviera.

penes-me-kolokithakia-kai-karota-ston-fo.title: Baked penne with courgettes and carrots
steps: Put the penne on to boil in a pan.
Grate the courgettes and carrots.
In another pan, sauté the carrots and courgettes in a little oil (after seasoning them with salt and pepper) and deglaze with the wine.
Leave it to absorb for a few minutes and add the cream, with salt and pepper. When the sauce starts to bubble, take the pan off the heat.
Preheat the oven to 180°C.

When the penne are cooked, drain them and mix them with the vegetable sauce in a small baking tin, together with 2-3 tbsp grated Parmesan. Before putting it in the oven, sprinkle over a little more Parmesan (as it melts, it will form a crust over the penne).
Bake for about 15 minutes.
Serve hot with a cool glass of white wine of your choice.

zimarika-me-kotopoulo-kai-kokkino-laxano.title: Pasta with chicken and red cabbage
steps: Add the shells to a pan of boiling salted water.
Cut the chicken fillets into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Wash the cabbage well, then finely chop it.
In a deep frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat and add the chicken.
Leave it to brown well and add the chopped cabbage.
Stir for 1-2 minutes, add a little salt and pepper and pour in the wine.
Lower the heat and leave to simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Drain the shells and add them to the frying pan with the chicken and cabbage.
Mix well and take off the heat.
Sprinkle with freshly grated Parmesan and serve immediately.

kokkinistes-soupies-me-kofto-makaronaki.title: Cuttlefish in tomato sauce with short macaroni
kokkinistes-soupies-me-kofto-makaronaki.description: A very tasty way to combine pasta and seafood.
steps: Cut the cuttlefish into rings and season with salt and pepper.
Add the olive oil to a pan and lightly sauté the onion.
Add the cuttlefish, stir well and deglaze with the wine.
Add two glasses of water and leave to simmer over a low heat.
Cuttlefish takes a while to soften, so leave it to simmer for at least an hour and a half, adding a little water now and then so there is always some sauce.
When the cuttlefish has softened, add the tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
In another pan, boil the macaroni in salted water.
Five minutes before they finish cooking, drain them and add them to the pan with the cuttlefish.
Leave them to cook with the cuttlefish for five to six minutes, always over a low heat and stirring often so they don't stick, then take the pan off the heat.

xulopites-me-manitaria-kai-anthotiro.title: Hilopites (egg noodles) with mushrooms and anthotyro
steps: Put the mushrooms with their oil in a shallow pan.
Season with salt and pepper and sauté lightly over a medium heat.
Add the hilopites and salt, sauté for 1 minute and pour in the wine.
Leave them to absorb the wine, stirring constantly so they don't stick, and add the water.
Boil for about 10 minutes, stirring now and then, then add the anthotyro.
Stir for 1-2 minutes and take the pan off the heat.
Serve immediately with plenty of freshly grated kefalotyri.

mpakaliaros-me-ntomatinia-kai-elies.title: Cod with cherry tomatoes and olives

items: 2 cod fillets of 100 g each (frozen, not salted)

steps: Add the rice to a pan of boiling salted water.
Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and lightly salt them.
Slice the olives lengthways.
In a non-stick frying pan, add the oil, cherry tomatoes, olives and cod fillets (without defrosting them), and season with salt and pepper.
Cook over a low heat for about 20 minutes, turning the fillets halfway through the cooking time so they cook evenly on both sides.
Add the chopped parsley to the pan and take it off the heat.
Drain the rice, which will have cooked by now.
Plate up each portion with a cod fillet, cherry tomatoes and olives, and garnish with a little rice moistened with the juices left by the cod and the other ingredients in the pan.

fileta-kotopoulou-pane.title: Breaded chicken fillets
steps: Season the fillets with salt and pepper.
In a deep plate, lightly beat the egg with a fork and dip the chicken fillets in it.
In a large non-stick frying pan, heat the olive oil over a medium heat.
Dip the fillets in the breadcrumbs, which you have tipped into a second plate.
Fry each side of the fillets in hot oil for 5 to 10 minutes, until golden.
Remove them from the pan and place them on a plate lined with kitchen paper to drain.
Serve hot, with mashed potato or rice.

kotopoulo-se-saltsa-gkorgkotzolas-me-gno.title: Chicken in gorgonzola sauce with gnocchi
kotopoulo-se-saltsa-gkorgkotzolas-me-gno.description: A dish for lovers of unique flavours!
steps: Season the chicken fillets with salt and pepper.
In a large frying pan, heat the olive oil over a medium heat.
Add the fillets and cook until golden on both sides.
Add the wine and leave to bubble for 1 to 2 minutes.
Lower the heat and add the gorgonzola, cut into pieces.
Stir with a wooden fork until the gorgonzola has melted.
Add the gnocchi to a pan of boiling salted water and cook according to the time on the packet (4 to 5 minutes is usually enough).
Meanwhile, simmer the fillets until the sauce thickens.
Drain the gnocchi, add them to the frying pan with the chicken and stir.
Take the pan off the heat and serve.

mprizoles-sto-alouminoxarto.title: Pork chops in foil
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
For each chop, take two long pieces of foil and lay them to form a cross.
Place each chop in the centre, after seasoning it with salt and pepper.
Top each chop with a potato cut into large cubes, a slice of the cheese and a slice of tomato.
Add 1-2 tbsp oil to each, then close the foil like a pouch.
Place the parcels in a small baking tin and put them in the oven.
Bake for about an hour and, for the last 15-20 minutes before taking them out, open the foil a little so the tops brown too.
Serve each one on a plate without removing it from the foil.

xoirines-mprizoles-me-kremmudia-kai-rizi.title: Pork chops with onions and rice
steps: Peel the onion and cut it into 1 cm rings.
Cook the rice in a pan of boiling salted water.
Take a large, deep frying pan and heat the olive oil over a medium heat.
Add the onions, season with salt and pepper and sauté lightly.
Season the chops with salt and pepper and add them to the pan.
Leave each side to sauté for 2-3 minutes and add the wine.
Keeping the heat medium, cook the chops, turning every so often, until they have absorbed the wine.
When they look ready, lower the heat and brown them for 2 minutes.
Remove the chops and half the onions from the pan.
Drain the rice and add it to the pan. Mix it well with the juices and the onions that remain.
Serve immediately, sprinkling the rice with freshly grated Parmesan.

prasina-fasolakia-me-tono.title: Green beans with tuna
prasina-fasolakia-me-tono.description: A light but very nourishing dish.
steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for 10-15 minutes (take care not to overcook them).
Drain them and leave for 5 minutes until completely drained.
Cut the tomatoes into cubes.
In a salad bowl, put the green beans, tomato and the tuna, drained of its oil.
Season with salt and pepper and add the oregano, olive oil and lemon juice.
Mix well and add the anthotyro.
Cover the bowl with cling film and put it in the fridge for 15 minutes.

tiropita-tis-stigmis.title: Quick cheese pie

items: ½ kg (2 sheets) frozen puff pastry

steps: Defrost the puff pastry sheets.
Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Butter your baking tin well.
Carefully lay one sheet on the buttered base of the tin.
In a bowl, mix the cheeses well with the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the mixture evenly over the sheet and cover with the other sheet, folding the edges inwards.
Brush the surface of the pastry with the egg yolk and put the tin in the oven for about 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden.

manitaropita.title: Mushroom pie
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a deep bowl and put them in a small baking tin for 1 hour at 200°C.

tarta-me-tiria-kai-kremmidia.title: Cheese and onion tart
steps: In a bowl, work all the pastry ingredients together, adding 1 to 2 tbsp water until the dough is soft.
Press the dough into a tart tin or a round baking tin.
Sauté the onion in a little butter and spread it in the tart tin.
Cover with the cheese.
Beat the eggs and add the cream and the salt.
Pour the mixture over the cheese and put it in the oven.
Bake at 180°C for about 40 minutes.

almires-krepes-fantasia.title: Savoury crepes fantasia
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Cut the cherry tomatoes into quarters and lightly salt them.
Cut the kasseri into thin slices.
Finely chop the lettuce and red cabbage.
Stone the olives and cut them into thin slices.
Cover half of each crepe with half the kasseri.
Divide the lettuce, red cabbage and olives between the two crepes, covering the kasseri you have just added.
Fold the crepes like an envelope and place them in a non-stick baking tin.
Bake for about 5 minutes, until the kasseri melts.
Serve hot with a spoonful of Russian salad.

zimi-gia-krepes.title: Crepe batter
steps: Whisk the flour with the milk, egg and salt until it becomes a batter.
Brush a non-stick frying pan with butter and heat it over a medium heat.
Take a small amount of the batter (about one ladle) and carefully pour it into the pan so that it covers the whole surface.
Leave the underside to cook for 1 to 2 minutes until golden, then carefully flip the crepe so that it doesn't break.
Cook the other side for 1 to 2 minutes and remove it from the pan.
Repeat the same process until the batter is used up.
Serve with a sweet or savoury filling.
You can keep the crepes in the fridge for a few days, placing a piece of kitchen paper between them.

zimi-gia-vasi-pitsas.title: Pizza base dough
steps: In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water and leave for five minutes.
Add 1½ cups flour, the sugar, the salt and the olive oil to the bowl.
Oil your hands with a little olive oil and mix very well.
It will stick to your hands at first, so keep kneading, adding a little flour at a time, until the dough is easy to shape.
Cover the bowl with a cotton towel and put it in the oven (without switching it on) for at least two hours.
After two hours the dough will have risen. Take a large non-stick baking tin and grease it well.
Oil your hands well too and spread the dough evenly in the tin.

keik-portokaliou-me-glaso-portokali.title: Orange cake with orange glaze
keik-portokaliou-me-glaso-portokali.description: A very tasty cake to sweeten the morning and go with an afternoon coffee.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Butter the baking tin (21 x 14 cm).
Beat the flour, baking powder, butter and sugar in a mixer until smooth.
Add the eggs, milk and orange zest and beat in the mixer for another minute or so.
Pour the mixture into the buttered tin and bake for about 50 minutes.
After 50 minutes, take the cake out of the oven and leave it to cool for 5 minutes.
Now make the glaze. Put all the ingredients in a non-stick saucepan and stir over a low heat until you have a smooth cream.
Carefully pour it over the cake (which you have placed on a platter) and leave it to cool for about 30 minutes.

keik-me-marmelada-fraoula.title: Cake with strawberry jam
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Butter the baking tin (21 x 14 cm).
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixer until smooth.
Add the eggs and mix them into the mixture.
Add the flour, baking powder and vanilla and beat in the mixer for about 1 minute.
Pour the mixture into the tin and bake for about 20 minutes.
When the cake is ready, take it out of the oven and leave it to cool for at least 5 minutes.
Turn it out onto a platter and, very carefully, cut it horizontally into two equal layers with a long knife.
Carefully lift off the top layer so that it doesn't break, and spread the jam over the top of the bottom layer.
Just as carefully, put the top layer back and dust the whole cake with icing sugar.

zesti-milopita.title: Warm apple pie
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Grease the baking tin (21 x 14 cm) well and line it with baking parchment.
Sprinkle the base of the tin with the 2 tbsp sugar mixed with the cinnamon.
Peel the apples and cut them into quarters.
Arrange them evenly over the sugar.
In a large bowl, beat the sugar and butter with a mixer. Add the eggs, flour, baking powder and vanilla and keep mixing until smooth.
Carefully pour the mixture over the apples and bake the pie for about 50 minutes.
Take it out of the oven and leave it to cool for 5-10 minutes.
Turn the tin upside down onto a platter and remove the parchment.
Serve sprinkled with a little cinnamon.

sfoliatakia-me-krema-kai-milo.title: Puff pastries with cream and apple
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Defrost the puff pastry sheet.
Brush a 6-hole cupcake tin well with oil.
Roll out the sheet and cut 6 circles of 11 cm.
Place each circle in a hole of the tin, pressing lightly so that it covers the base and sides.
In a bowl, mix the mascarpone with 1 tbsp sugar using a spoon.
Peel the apple, cut it into quarters and then into thin slices.
In a second bowl, mix the apple slices with the cinnamon, the chocolate chips and 1½ tbsp sugar.
Put 1½ tsp of the mascarpone mixture in each hole.
Divide the apple mixture between the holes, covering the mascarpone.
Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes, take them out of the oven and leave them to cool for 5 minutes before removing them from the tin.

tiramisou.title: Tiramisu
steps: In a bowl, beat the egg yolks with the sugar using a mixer, then add the mascarpone and mix until smooth.
In another bowl, whisk the egg whites (meringue) and slowly fold them into the first mixture.
In a deep plate, mix the espresso with a little milk if you want a less intense coffee flavour.
Lightly dip the savoiardi in the coffee and milk mixture and make the first layer in your tin.
Spread some of the cream over the savoiardi and repeat in this order, savoiardi first and then cream, making sure to finish with a thin layer of cream on top of the dessert.
Sift cocoa powder over the cream and put the dessert in the fridge for 4 hours.

cheesecake-rodakino.title: Peach cheesecake
steps: In a bowl, mix the base ingredients. Using your palms, spread and press the mixture to cover the base of a springform tin (26 cm).
Using a mixer, beat the mascarpone, Philadelphia, sugar and egg yolk until smooth.
In another bowl, beat the egg white with the mixer until frothy and slowly fold it into the mascarpone mixture.
Pour the new mixture over the biscuit base and leave it in the fridge for 3-4 hours.
With gentle movements, spread the jam over the mascarpone mixture and leave it in the fridge for another hour.
Once chilled, take it out of the fridge, unclip the ring of the tin and carefully remove the cheesecake.

soufledakia-sokolatas.title: Little chocolate soufflés
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Butter a 12-hole cupcake tin well, then dust it with flour.
In a small non-stick saucepan, melt the dark chocolate with the butter over a low heat, then take it off the heat and leave it to cool a little.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites.
Beat the yolks with the sugar and then add the chocolate mixture, which will have cooled slightly by now.
Whisk the egg whites for 3-4 minutes until they form a frothy mousse (meringue).
Fold the first mixture into the meringue and beat in the mixer for about two more minutes.
Fill each hole of the tin two-thirds full with the mixture you have just made and bake for about 25 minutes.
Wait 5 minutes before taking them out of the tin and serve warm with a little whipped cream.

muffin-me-kardia-sokolatas.title: Muffins with a chocolate heart
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Butter your muffin tin well.
In a bowl, beat the sugar and eggs with a mixer.
Add the remaining ingredients (flour, butter, milk, baking powder and vanilla) and beat in the mixer for another 1-2 minutes.
Put 3 tbsp of the mixture in each muffin hole.
Carefully put a spoonful of chocolate hazelnut spread in each one and then cover it with a spoonful of the batter.
Put them in the oven for 20 minutes.
Leave them to cool for 5 minutes before taking them out of the tin.
Serve sprinkled with a little icing sugar.

muffin-me-indokarido-kai-glaso-sokolatas.title: Coconut muffins with chocolate glaze
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Butter a 12-hole muffin tin well.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, butter and sugar for 1 minute using a hand mixer.
Add the eggs, milk, orange juice and orange zest and keep mixing with the mixer until smooth.
Add the coconut and mix for another half a minute.
Fill each hole about two-thirds full with the mixture and put them in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Leave them to cool for 5 to 10 minutes and remove them from the tin.
Meanwhile, make the chocolate glaze. In a pan set over another pan of boiling water (bain-marie), melt the chocolate with the butter and icing sugar, then take it off the heat.
Leave the chocolate glaze to cool slightly for 1 minute and then carefully spread it over the muffins. Use a brush to cover the sides.
Leave for about an hour for the glaze to set and serve sprinkled with coconut.

tragana-mpiskota-me-stagones-sokolatas.title: Crunchy biscuits with chocolate chips
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Put the flour, orange zest and butter in a bowl and mix with a hand mixer on low speed for 2 to 3 minutes.
Gradually add the sugar, orange juice, egg and chocolate chips and keep mixing, increasing the speed of the mixer, until combined into a smooth mixture.
Grease a baking tray well with oil or butter and cover it with baking parchment.
Place 2 tbsp of the mixture on the tray for each biscuit, leaving a gap of about 5 cm between them.
Sprinkle them with 2 tbsp sugar and put them in the oven.
Bake for about 20 minutes, until golden.

krepes-me-sokolata-kai-maskarpone.title: Crepes with chocolate and mascarpone
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Lightly butter a non-stick baking tin.
Spread 1½ tbsp chocolate hazelnut spread on each crepe and add 3 tsp mascarpone.
Roll them up and place them in the tin.
Sprinkle them with cocoa and put them in the oven for 5 minutes.
As soon as you take them out, serve immediately sprinkled with icing sugar.

tiganites-mpananes.title: Fried bananas
steps: Peel the bananas and cut each one in half lengthways.
Soak them in the orange juice for 15 minutes.
In a wide frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat.
Take the bananas out of the orange juice and dip them in the flour, which you have tipped into a deep plate.
Fry the floured bananas in hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Carefully remove them from the pan and place them on a plate lined with kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil.
Sprinkle them with the sugar and leave them to cool for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with icing sugar and cinnamon.
